title: Zendesk Pricing Plans and Total Costs for 2026
summary: Zendesk pricing structures vary based on your team size and feature needs. You can evaluate your total budget and choose the right tier for your business.
body_markdown:
## Zendesk pricing plans for 2026 defined


On January 1, 2026, Zendesk shifted its operations to a tiered subscription model. Costs scale based on human seat count and the depth of automation features required.


While the entry-level plans provide basic ticketing, the platform’s true capabilities and its highest costs are locked behind higher tiers. These levels gate essential business functions like custom reporting and advanced AI routing.


### The Support Team and Suite Team entry points


$19 per agent, per month is the starting price for the Support Team plan when billed annually. This is a foundational ticketing system for small teams that only need to manage email and social media requests in one place.


When a business requires a unified workspace that includes live chat and voice, the Suite Team plan at $55 per agent, per month becomes the functional baseline.


This jump in price means a five-person team pays significantly more just to access the "Suite" features, such as a basic help center for customer self-service.


At this level, teams often use[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) , which offers unlimited flows on every plan to automate the exchange of data between business apps, ensuring entry-level workflows remain functional without jumping to a more expensive[Zendesk](https://zendesk.com/pricing) tier.


### Suite Growth and Professional mid-market tiers


Moving into the mid-market tiers introduces tools for managing larger volumes of data and more complex team structures. The Suite Professional plan costs $115 per agent, per month, which means a team of ten will incur a recurring expense of $1,150 every thirty days.


This is the minimum requirement for companies that need to track Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The following table illustrates how these mid-market choices impact daily operations:


Tier Monthly Cost (Annual) SLA Management Custom Roles AI Agent Inclusion


**Suite Team** $55 Not included No Limited


**Suite Growth** $89 Included No Standard


**Suite Professional** $115 Advanced Yes Advanced


**Enterprise** $215 Full Customization Unlimited Full Access


*Prices and plan limits checked against[zendesk.com](https://zendesk.com/pricing) on September 29, 2026.*


By choosing Professional over Growth, managers gain the ability to create custom agent roles.


### Zendesk Enterprise and Enterprise Plus pricing


Organizations that treat support as a data-driven operation are the primary targets for the Enterprise tiers. These plans start at $215 per agent, per month, so a company must budget over two thousand dollars monthly for every ten seats added.


This price point grants access to the "Advanced Data Privacy and Protection" add-on.


For companies handling sensitive health or financial information, this level of security is necessary.


At this scale, the cost isn't just about the people answering phones. It's about the "AI Agents" that handle routine queries.


Frontier models like Gemini 3.8 Flash for coding tasks or GPT-6 Luna for high-volume ticket sorting require these top-tier plans. On the Enterprise tiers, this shift toward automation is the only way to justify the high per-seat cost.


It allows a small team to manage a massive customer base.
